name: Denos City
source:
The main character (MC) is a young man who recently moved to Denos City and there meets Richard Collins, a wealthy and prestigious lawyer and further interacts with his family. But nothing is as it seems, and you have to discover the mystery surrounding MC’s past.​

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/backhole]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名剛搬到Denos市的年輕男子。在這裡，他結識了富有且聲望卓著的律師理查・柯林斯，並也漸漸和他的家人熟識。然而，一切都不像表面上那麼簡單，你必須揭開圍繞主角過去的謎團。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/backhole]Patreon[/url]]
